seed data directly (68 `add()` calls), not copied from prior reports.
**Supersedes / extends:** `docs/readiness-bank-report.md` (2026-08-15).

### Clumping Analysis

**⚠️ The bank clumps at 0.7–0.8:** 27 items (39.7%) sit in the
0.7–0.8 band. The floor is well covered (5 items at 0.10) but the 0.9+ band is
thin and there is no 1.0 item (hardest = 0.96).

| Bin | Count | % of Bank |
|-----|-------|-----------|
| 0.1–0.2 | 7 | 10.3% |
| 0.3–0.4 | 13 | 19.1% |
| 0.5–0.6 | 15 | 22.1% |
| 0.7–0.8 | 27 | 39.7% |
| 0.9–1.0 | 6 | 8.8% |

**Recommended fix:** author 8–10 new fresh items at 0.20–0.25, 0.90–0.95, and
0.98–1.00 to flatten the distribution (see §6 Action Items).

## 7. Action Items

1. **Code-comment mismatch:** `seedReadinessItems()` comment claims 60 items;
   actual bank is 68. Update the comment to match reality.
2. **Difficulty clumping:** 39.7% of items at 0.7–0.8. Author 8–10 fresh items
   at 0.2–0.25 and 0.9–1.0 to flatten.
3. **NGN gap:** maternity has 0 NGN items. Add 1–2 SATA-style maternity items.
4. **Draft fence:** temporarily set one item to `reviewStatus: 'draft'` and
   verify the API refuses to serve it (planted-violation test).
